Strategy: Add an exact-fit bonus on top of the widened gentle fifteen sweet band and mid penalty, so perfectly filled bins always win. This combines three preferences that each helped alone, but the exact-fit override may dominate and hide the band effects.
```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [1000.0 if r - item == 0 else (-(r - item) + (15 if r - item >= 28 and r - item <= 48 else 0) - (15 if r - item >= 8 and r - item <= 22 else 0)) for r in bins]
```
